title: Uptime
subtitle: Outside-in HTTP, TCP, heartbeat, DNS, and optional ping (SKU cap).
name: Name
limitReached: Uptime seat limit reached for this SKU.
emptyHint: Add an outside-in check for this workspace.
heartbeatHint: Save to receive a one-time push URL. Token is not stored in plaintext.
pingDisabled: ICMP ping is off unless UPTIME_ICMP is enabled on the server.
expectStatusHint: Empty = any 200–399. Set an exact code (e.g. 204).
historyEmpty: No samples in the last 7 days.
probeRule: HTTP is up on 200–399 unless you set an expected status. User-Agent: SinexisUptime/1.0. Down after 2 failed ticks.
hintRefused: TCP refused: origin is not listening or a firewall dropped the probe (not an HTTP status).
hintTimeout: Probe timed out before a response. Origin may be slow or filtered.
hint403: HTTP reached the host; 403 is a deny (WAF, geo, or auth). Allowlist SinexisUptime/1.0 or set expected status 403 if that is healthy.
hint401: HTTP reached the host; 401 means auth is required. Add an Authorization header or expect 401 if that is healthy.
hint5xx: Origin returned a server error. The site answered, but the application failed.
hintStatus: HTTP completed but the status is outside 200–399 (or did not match expected status).
hintTls: TLS handshake or certificate failed. The probe verifies certificates.
hintDns: Hostname did not resolve from the probe network.
